import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { TextInput } from '../components/TextInput';
import { FieldGroup } from '../components/FieldGroup';
import { LiquidMetalCard } from '../components/LiquidMetalCard';
import { Badge } from '../components/Badge';

interface Candidate {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  skills: string[];
  status: 'active' | 'interviewing' | 'hired' | 'rejected';
  experienceLevel: 'junior' | 'mid' | 'senior';
}

interface CandidateSearchFilterProps {
  candidates: Candidate[];
  onFilterChange: (filtered: Candidate[]) => void;
}

export function CandidateSearchFilter({ candidates, onFilterChange }: CandidateSearchFilterProps): JSX.Element {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedSkills, setSelectedSkills] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedStatus, setSelectedStatus] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const allSkills = useMemo(() => {
    const skills = new Set<string>();
    candidates.forEach(c => c.skills.forEach(s => skills.add(s)));
    return Array.from(skills).sort();
  }, [candidates]);

  const filteredCandidates = useMemo(() => {
    return candidates.filter(candidate => {
      const matchesSearch = searchQuery === '' || 
        candidate.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
      const matchesSkills = selectedSkills.length === 0 || 
        selectedSkills.some(skill => candidate.skills.includes(skill));
      const matchesStatus = selectedStatus.length === 0 || 
        selectedStatus.includes(candidate.status);
      return matchesSearch && matchesSkills && matchesStatus;
    });
  }, [candidates, searchQuery, selectedSkills, selectedStatus]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    onFilterChange(filteredCandidates);
  }, [filteredCandidates, onFilterChange]);

  const clearFilters = (): void => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    setSelectedSkills([]);
    setSelectedStatus([]);
  };

  const activeFilterCount = selectedSkills.length + selectedStatus.length + (searchQuery ? 1 : 0);

  return (
    <LiquidMetalCard className="mb-4">
      <FieldGroup label="Search & Filter" className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex gap-2 items-center">
          <TextInput
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search by name..."
            className="flex-1"
          />
          <select
            multiple
            value={selectedSkills}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedSkills(Array.from(e.target.selectedOptions, o => o.value))}
            className="border rounded px-2 py-1"
          >
            <option value="">All Skills</option>
            {allSkills.map(skill => (
              <option key={skill} value={skill}>{skill}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <select
            value={selectedStatus[0] || ''}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedStatus(e.target.value ? [e.target.value] : [])}
            className="border rounded px-2 py-1"
          >
            <option value="">All Status</option>
            <option value="active">Active</option>
            <option value="interviewing">Interviewing</option>
            <option value="hired">Hired</option>
            <option value="rejected">Rejected</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        
        {activeFilterCount > 0 && (
          <div className="flex gap-2 items-center flex-wrap">
            {searchQuery && (
              <Badge variant="QUIZ_MCQ">Search: {searchQuery}</Badge>
            )}
            {selectedSkills.map(skill => (
              <Badge key={skill} variant="QUIZ_MCQ">{skill}</Badge>
            ))}
            {selectedStatus.map(status => (
              <Badge key={status} variant="CODE_REVIEW">{status}</Badge>
            ))}
            <button 
              onClick={clearFilters}
              className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 text-sm ml-auto"
            >
              Clear all
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </FieldGroup>
    </LiquidMetalCard>
  );
}
